1970.notes: RSMo 1969 sec. 143.010 (Missouri State Archives / Missouri Digital Heritage scan of the Revised Statutes of Missouri 1969, vol. 2, p. 1190; RSMo 1939 sec. 11343 as last amended by L. 1959 H.B. 395), in force until replaced by L. 1972 S.B. 549 (RSMo 143.011, effective 1-1-1973); the 1971 Cumulative Supplement contains no amendment. Federal income tax deductible (not modelled).
